title: 乐芙兰·镜前蝴蝶结
description: 黑发乐芙兰保留金色尖冠与紫色法杖，穿完整高领衣装，在小镜前整理发带。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: LeBlanc is an adult pale-faced mage with sleek dark hair, dramatic violet eye makeup, a tall gold angular crown, and a purple-black aristocratic silhouette. Preserve her recognizable cape and ornate staff with a violet crystal, but give her a fully covering high-neck long-sleeved dress, opaque tights, and boots. The staff rests safely beside the mirror, with no illusion copies or threatening magic.
art_direction.scene: She sits before a plain oval mirror and ties a small violet ribbon around one lock of hair, smiling at the slightly crooked bow. A single unlettered perfume bottle and a folded cloth decorate the dressing table. Her crown fits within the square, and the original quiet pose feels playful rather than sinister.
art_direction.palette: deep violet, black hair, pale gold, dusty lilac
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
